newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kapuni decision still unclear - FCL Energy.
newsitem.headline: Kapuni decision still unclear - FCL Energy.

text.p: Fletcher Energy said on Wednesday the implications of the February 3 High Court decision on the Kapuni field remained unclear but that it was considering an appeal of various aspects of the decision.

The High Court ruled on the dispute between the owners of the offshore field, Shell (Petroleum Mining) Co Ltd and Todd Petroleum Mining Co Ltd, Fletcher Challenge Energy and Natural Gas Corp, over entitlements to gas from the field.
The court upheld all of the terms of the existing contract, directing the parties to negotiate volumes and prices or, in the event of their failure to agree, submit those issues to arbitration.

"However, the company is considering appealing aspects of the finding that, on competition grounds, 50 percent of the output of the Kapuni field is to be awarded to Shell/Todd after April 1, 1997," FCL Energy said.
"Hence, the full financial and operational implications for FCL Energy will not be cledar until these remaining outstanding issues are resolved," it said.
FCL Energy earlier reported a sharp rise in profit for the six months to December 31 to NZ$126 million, up from $20.0 million the same year-ago period.
